questions.context_sentence: News about natural disasters.
questions.cn: 关于自然灾害的新闻。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：dis-（否定/坏）+ aster（星星）= 坏星星，古人认为流星坠落代表灾难。

questions.context_sentence: A large tornado moving across an open field near a building.
questions.cn: 一场大型龙卷风正穿过建筑物附近的开阔田野。
questions.hint: 谐音记忆：“拖泥带斗”的龙卷风把泥土卷到半空中。

questions.context_sentence: Tick the disasters that you hear: drought.
questions.cn: 勾选你听到的灾害：干旱。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：dry（干的）演变而来，ough发/aʊ/音，t结尾。干旱无雨。

questions.context_sentence: What caused the landslide in Seoul?
questions.cn: 是什么导致了首尔的滑坡？
questions.hint: 组合记忆：land（土地）+ slide（滑动）= 土地滑动，即滑坡。

questions.context_sentence: The landslide made the rocks slide down the mountain.
questions.cn: 山体滑坡使得岩石顺着山坡滑落下来。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：s + lide（滑梯）。在游乐场玩滑梯就是slide。

questions.context_sentence: A massive tsunami wave crashing into an Asian coastal city.
questions.cn: 巨大的海啸巨浪冲击着亚洲沿海城市。
questions.hint: 外来语记忆：来自日语“津波”（tsunami），tsu（津，港口）+ nami（波，浪）。

questions.context_sentence: Where are the floods?
questions.cn: 洪水在哪里？
questions.hint: 联想记忆：fl（流）+ ood（读/ʌd/，像血blood）。洪水就像流淌的浑水。
questions.prompt: Where are the ____? (提示: 洪水；大量)

questions.context_sentence: Tick the disasters that you hear: volcanic eruption.
questions.cn: 勾选你听到的灾害：火山喷发。
questions.hint: 组合记忆：volcanic（火山的）+ eruption（喷发，erupt的名词形式）。

questions.context_sentence: What was the magnitude of the earthquake in Ecuador?
questions.cn: 厄瓜多尔地震的震级是多少？
questions.hint: 词根记忆：magn（大）+ i + tude（名词后缀，表状态）= 大小、级别。

questions.context_sentence: Tick the disasters that you hear: volcano.
questions.cn: 勾选你听到的灾害：火山。
questions.hint: 背景记忆：源自罗马神话中的火神武尔坎（Vulcan）。
questions.prompt: Tick the disasters that you hear: ____.

questions.context_sentence: What are the rescue workers and soldiers doing in the flood-hit area?
questions.cn: 救援人员和士兵在受洪水袭击的地区做什么？
questions.hint: 联想记忆：re（再次）+ s + cue（线索/提示）-> 再次发现线索，展开营救。

questions.context_sentence: Which buildings were damaged in Seoul?
questions.cn: 首尔有哪些建筑遭到破坏？
questions.hint: 联想记忆：dam（大坝）+ age（年龄）。大坝有年龄了，开始受到损坏。

questions.context_sentence: 2,400 homes destroyed.
questions.cn: 2,400所房屋被毁。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：de（向下，变坏）+ stroy（建造，与structure同源）= 拆毁，摧毁。

questions.context_sentence: Almost 88,000 people evacuated.
questions.cn: 近88,000人被疏散。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：e-（出）+ vacu（空，与vacant同源）+ ate（动词后缀）= 撤空，疏散。

questions.context_sentence: Planes, helicopters used to fight the fire.
questions.cn: 飞机和直升机被用来灭火。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：helico（螺旋）+ pter（翅膀）= 旋转翅膀的飞机，即直升机。
questions.prompt: Planes, ____ used to fight the fire.

questions.context_sentence: Shelters set up by the government.
questions.cn: 政府建立的避难所。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：shell（贝壳）+ ter -> 像贝壳一样的保护所，避难处。

questions.context_sentence: The Red Cross Society of China is supplying the disaster-hit area with medical supplies.
questions.cn: 中国红十字会正在向灾区提供医疗物资。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：sup（在...下面，引申为补充）+ ply（折叠/填满）= 补充，供应。

questions.context_sentence: We received aid from the people.
questions.cn: 我们收到了人民的援助。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：aid 帮助。first aid是急救。

questions.context_sentence: Prepare an emergency bag with water, biscuits, a torch and a first-aid kit.
questions.cn: 准备一个装有水、饼干、手电筒和急救箱的应急包。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：猫咪（kitten）的简写是kit。成套的猫咪工具。

questions.context_sentence: Prepare an emergency bag with water, biscuits, a torch and a first-aid kit.
questions.cn: 准备一个装有水、饼干、手电筒和急救箱的应急包。
questions.hint: 组合记忆：first（第一，紧急）+ aid（援助）+ kit（箱，包）= 急救箱。

questions.context_sentence: No deaths, no injuries.
questions.cn: 无死亡，无受伤。
questions.hint: 词性记忆：dead（形容词，死的）的名词形式，结尾变成th。

questions.meaning: 影响；(疾病)侵袭；深深打动
questions.context_sentence: 82 killed, 500,000 affected.
questions.cn: 82人死亡，50万人受灾。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：af-（去）+ fect（做，作用）= 产生作用，影响。
questions.prompt: 82 killed, 500,000 ____. (提示: 影响；(疾病)侵袭；深深打动)

questions.context_sentence: There were deep cracks that appeared in the well walls.
questions.cn: 水井壁上出现了深深的裂缝。
questions.hint: 拟声记忆：噼啪的破裂声，引申为“裂纹，裂缝”。

questions.context_sentence: At least one well had some smelly gas coming out of it.
questions.cn: 至少有一口井里冒出一些难闻的气体。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：gas（煤气/汽油），gas station是加油站。

questions.context_sentence: It seemed as if the world were coming to an end!
questions.cn: 看起来世界仿佛就要走到尽头了！
questions.hint: 短语记忆：as（如同）+ if（如果）= 就像是，仿佛。
questions.prompt: It seemed ____ the world were coming to an end!

questions.context_sentence: In less than one minute, a large city lay in ruins.
questions.cn: 不到一分钟，一座大城市就变成了一片废墟。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：ru（如）+ in（在...里）= 掉进废墟里了。

questions.context_sentence: In less than one minute, a large city lay in ruins.
questions.cn: 不到一分钟，一座大城市就变成了一片废墟。
questions.hint: 短语记忆：in（在...中）+ ruins（废墟）= 处于废墟之中。

questions.context_sentence: About 75 percent of the city's factories and buildings, 90 percent of its homes, and all of its hospitals were gone.
questions.cn: 大约百分之七十五的工厂和建筑、百分之九十的住宅以及所有的医院都消失了。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：per（每）+ cent（百，如cent分币）= 每一百中，百分之。
questions.prompt: About 75 ____ of the city's factories and buildings were gone.

questions.context_sentence: Bricks covered the ground like red autumn leaves.
questions.cn: 砖块铺满地面，就像红色的秋叶。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：br（桥）+ ick -> 用砖头（brick）砌成的桥。

questions.context_sentence: The railway tracks were now useless pieces of metal.
questions.cn: 铁轨现在成了毫无用处的金属废品。
questions.hint: 对比记忆：metal是金属，mental是精神的。少个n（脑），就只是冰冷的金属。

questions.context_sentence: People were in shock—and then, later that afternoon, another big quake shook Tangshan again.
questions.cn: 人们处于震惊之中——随后，那天下午晚些时候，又一场大地震再次震撼了唐山。
questions.hint: 拟声联想：受到电击或巨大打击时的吃惊反应。像“触电”。
questions.prompt: People were in ____—and then another big quake shook Tangshan again.

questions.context_sentence: People were in shock.
questions.cn: 人们感到震惊。
questions.hint: 短语记忆：in（处于...状态）+ shock（震惊）。

questions.context_sentence: Water, food, and electricity were hard to get.
questions.cn: 水、食物和电很难弄到。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：electric（电的）+ ity（名词后缀）= 电，电能。

questions.context_sentence: Soon after the quakes, the army sent 150,000 soldiers to Tangshan to dig out those who were trapped.
questions.cn: 地震后不久，军队派出了15万士兵前往唐山，把那些被困的人挖出来。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：t + rap（说唱）= 说唱歌手掉进了陷阱。
questions.prompt: Soon after the quakes, soldiers went to dig out those who were ____.

questions.context_sentence: To dig out those who were trapped and to bury the dead.
questions.cn: 救出被困人员并安葬死者。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：发音像 berry（浆果）。把坏的浆果埋进土里。

questions.context_sentence: Slowly, the city began to breathe again.
questions.cn: 慢慢地，城市开始重新呼吸。
questions.hint: 词性对比：breath 是名词 /breθ/，加上e变成动词 breathe /briːð/。

questions.context_sentence: Tangshan started to revive itself and get back up on its feet.
questions.cn: 唐山开始复苏并重新站立起来。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：re-（重新）+ viv（活，如vivid生动的）+ e = 重新活过来，复活。
questions.prompt: Tangshan started to ____ itself and get back up on its feet.

questions.context_sentence: The economic revival of the earthquake zone.
questions.cn: 地震灾区的经济复苏。
questions.hint: 词性记忆：revive（动词）+ al（名词后缀）= 振兴，复苏。

questions.context_sentence: With strong support from the government and the tireless efforts of the city's people.
questions.cn: 在政府的大力支持和市民的不懈努力下。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：ef-（出）+ fort（强壮，如force力）-> 出力，尽力，努力。

questions.context_sentence: Show the wisdom to stay positive and rebuild for a brighter future.
questions.cn: 展现保持积极、为更美好未来而重建的智慧。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：wise（聪明的）+ dom（名词后缀，表领域/状态）= 智慧。
questions.prompt: Show the ____ to stay positive and rebuild for a brighter future.

questions.context_sentence: A typhoon is an extremely strong wind.
questions.cn: 台风是极强的风。
questions.hint: 谐音记忆：发音非常接近中文的“台风”。

questions.context_sentence: A hurricane causes massive damage in America.
questions.cn: 飓风在美国造成了巨大的破坏。
questions.hint: 谐音记忆：“赫里肯”飓风刮得很急（hurry），还卷起甘蔗（cane）。
questions.prompt: A ____ causes massive damage in America.

questions.context_sentence: Few sheep and cows survived the snowstorm.
questions.cn: 很少有绵羊和奶牛在暴风雪中幸存下来。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：sur-（在...之上/超越）+ vive（活）= 越过危险活下来，幸存。

questions.context_sentence: Stay away from windows and power lines.
questions.cn: 远离窗户和电线。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：pow（象声词，出拳的声音）+ er -> 力量，能量。

questions.context_sentence: He tapped on the pipe to make a sound.
questions.cn: 他轻敲管子发出声音。
questions.hint: 拟声词：tap, tap, tap，轻敲的声音。
questions.prompt: He ____ on the pipe to make a sound. (提示: 轻叩；轻敲)

questions.context_sentence: Water pipes were broken.
questions.cn: 水管破裂了。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：形似一根管子，两个p夹着i，再跟一个e。

questions.context_sentence: He blew his whistle for help.
questions.cn: 他吹响哨子求救。
questions.hint: 拟声词：whistle的发音十分接近吹哨子时的嘘嘘声。

questions.context_sentence: Prepare an emergency bag.
questions.cn: 准备一个应急包。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：emerge（出现，浮现）+ ency（名词后缀）-> 突然冒出来的大事，即紧急情况。

questions.context_sentence: Staying calm is the most important rule.
questions.cn: 保持镇静是最重要的规则。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：l不发音，卡姆（calm），安静下来。

questions.context_sentence: A truck went out of control and crashed into the back of a bus.
questions.cn: 一辆卡车失控撞上了公共汽车的尾部。
questions.hint: 拟声记忆：crash，重物撞击、碎裂的声音。
questions.prompt: A truck went out of control and ____ into the back of a bus.

questions.context_sentence: People must unify and show the wisdom to stay positive.
questions.cn: 人们必须团结一致，展现保持积极的智慧。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：uni（单一）+ fy（使...化）= 使合为一体，统一。

questions.context_sentence: Use context to understand new words.
questions.cn: 利用上下文来理解生词。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：con-（共同）+ text（文本）= 结合在一起的文本，即上下文。

questions.context_sentence: What kind of help do you think people who have suffered from a tsunami need?
questions.cn: 你认为遭受海啸袭击的人们需要什么样的帮助？
questions.hint: 联想记忆：suf（向下）+ fer（带/承受）-> 在下面承受痛苦，遭受。

questions.context_sentence: A mountain from which gas, ash, and hot rocks sometimes erupt.
questions.cn: 一座有时会喷出气体、灰烬和热岩石的山。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：e-（出）+ rupt（破，断裂）= 破土而出，爆发。

questions.context_sentence: People had to sleep in the open air.
questions.cn: 人们不得不睡在露天里。
questions.hint: 直译记忆：in（在...中）+ open air（开阔的空气中）= 露天。

questions.context_sentence: Fortunately, volunteers were on hand to help people move.
questions.cn: 幸好有志愿者在现场帮助人们搬迁。
questions.hint: 直译记忆：就在手边（on hand），随时可以提供帮助。

questions.context_sentence: A raging wildfire sweeping through a dense forest.
questions.cn: 肆虐的山火席卷了茂密的森林。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：s + weep（哭泣）= 拿着扫帚一边扫地一边哭泣。
questions.prompt: A raging wildfire ____ through a dense forest.

questions.context_sentence: A massive tsunami wave.
questions.cn: 巨大的海啸浪潮。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：水波（wave）起伏，像手在挥舞（wave）。

questions.context_sentence: An earthquake can strike suddenly.
questions.cn: 地震可能会突然袭来。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：保龄球全倒叫strike，给人以强烈的击打和侵袭感。

questions.context_sentence: Volunteers delivered food and supplies.
questions.cn: 志愿者们运送了食物和物资。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：de（向下）+ liver（肝脏/生命的供给）-> 送达生存必需品，即递送。

questions.context_sentence: Write a summary of the text.
questions.cn: 写一篇课文的总结。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：sum（总数，合计）+ ary（名词后缀）= 总结，概括。

questions.context_sentence: This project will have a huge effect on girls' education.
questions.cn: 这个项目将对女孩的教育产生巨大的影响。
questions.hint: 对比记忆：affect是动词（影响），effect是名词（效果）。

questions.context_sentence: Write a summary of appropriate length.
questions.cn: 写一篇长度合适的总结。
questions.hint: 词性记忆：long（形容词，长的）的名词形式，发音和拼写发生改变。

questions.context_sentence: The landslide made the rocks slide down the mountain.
questions.cn: 山体滑坡使得岩石顺着山坡滑落下来。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：s + lide（滑梯）。在游乐场玩滑梯就是slide。
questions.prompt: The landslide made the rocks ____ down the mountain.

questions.meaning: n. 洪水；大量 & vi. 淹没；大量涌入 & vt. 使灌满水；淹没
questions.context_sentence: Where are the floods?
questions.cn: 洪水在哪里？
questions.hint: 联想记忆：fl（流）+ ood（读/ʌd/，像血blood）。洪水就像流淌的浑水。
options: n. 洪水；大量 & vi. 淹没；大量涌入 & vt. 使灌满水；淹没
n. 流动；流淌 & vi. 流动
n. 火焰；光芒 & vi. 燃烧

questions.meaning: vt. 损害；破坏 & n. 损坏；损失
questions.context_sentence: Which buildings were damaged in Seoul?
questions.cn: 首尔有哪些建筑遭到破坏？
questions.hint: 联想记忆：dam（大坝）+ age（年龄）。大坝有年龄了，开始受到损坏。
options: vt. 损害；破坏 & n. 损坏；损失
vt. 危险；威胁 & n. 危险
vt. 摧毁；毁灭 & n. 毁灭
vt. 污染；弄脏 & n. 污染
vt. 纠正；修改 & n. 改正
vt. 控制；管理 & n. 控制

questions.context_sentence: 2,400 homes destroyed.
questions.cn: 2,400所房屋被毁。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：de（向下，变坏）+ stroy（建造，与structure同源）= 拆毁，摧毁。

questions.meaning: vt. 疏散；撤出 & vi. 撤离
questions.context_sentence: Almost 88,000 people evacuated.
questions.cn: 近88,000人被疏散。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：e-（出）+ vacu（空，与vacant同源）+ ate（动词后缀）= 撤空，疏散。
options: vt. 疏散；撤出 & vi. 撤离

questions.meaning: vt. 影响；(疾病)侵袭；深深打动
questions.context_sentence: 82 killed, 500,000 affected.
questions.cn: 82人死亡，50万人受灾。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：af-（去）+ fect（做，作用）= 产生作用，影响。
options: vt. 影响；(疾病)侵袭；深深打动

questions.meaning: n. 裂纹；裂缝 & vi. & vt. (使)破裂
questions.context_sentence: There were deep cracks that appeared in the well walls.
questions.cn: 水井壁上出现了深深的裂缝。
questions.hint: 拟声记忆：噼啪的破裂声，引申为“裂纹，裂缝”。
questions.prompt: There were deep ____ that appeared in the well walls.

questions.meaning: vt. 使落入险境 & n. 险境；陷阱
questions.context_sentence: Soon after the quakes, the army sent 150,000 soldiers to Tangshan to dig out those who were trapped.
questions.cn: 地震后不久，军队派出了15万士兵前往唐山，把那些被困的人挖出来。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：t + rap（说唱）= 说唱歌手掉进了陷阱。
options: vt. 使落入险境 & n. 险境；陷阱
vt. 抓住；紧抓 & n. 抓
vt. 绊倒；犯错误 & n. 绊
vt. 滴落 & n. 水滴
vt. 轻叩；轻敲 & n. 水龙头
vt. 拍打；轻拍 & n. 拍打

questions.context_sentence: To dig out those who were trapped and to bury the dead.
questions.cn: 救出被困人员并安葬死者。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：发音像 berry（浆果）。把坏的浆果埋进土里。
questions.prompt: To dig out those who were trapped and to ____ the dead. (提示: 埋葬；安葬)

questions.context_sentence: Slowly, the city began to breathe again.
questions.cn: 慢慢地，城市开始重新呼吸。
questions.hint: 词性对比：breath 是名词 /breθ/，加上e变成动词 breathe /briːð/。

questions.context_sentence: Tangshan started to revive itself and get back up on its feet.
questions.cn: 唐山开始复苏并重新站立起来。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：re-（重新）+ viv（活，如vivid生动的）+ e = 重新活过来，复活。

questions.meaning: vi. & vt. 统一；(使)成一体
questions.context_sentence: People must unify and show the wisdom to stay positive.
questions.cn: 人们必须团结一致，展现保持积极的智慧。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：uni（单一）+ fy（使...化）= 使合为一体，统一。
questions.prompt: People must ____ and show the wisdom to stay positive.

questions.meaning: vt. 遭受 & vi. (因疾病、痛苦、悲伤等)受苦
questions.context_sentence: What kind of help do you think people who have suffered from a tsunami need?
questions.cn: 你认为遭受海啸袭击的人们需要什么样的帮助？
questions.hint: 联想记忆：suf（向下）+ fer（带/承受）-> 在下面承受痛苦，遭受。
options: vt. 遭受 & vi. (因疾病、痛苦、悲伤等)受苦

questions.context_sentence: A mountain from which gas, ash, and hot rocks sometimes erupt.
questions.cn: 一座有时会喷出气体、灰烬和热岩石的山。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：e-（出）+ rupt（破，断裂）= 破土而出，爆发。
questions.prompt: A mountain from which gas, ash, and hot rocks sometimes ____.

questions.meaning: n. 供应(量)；[pl.] 补给品 & vt. 供应；供给
questions.context_sentence: The Red Cross Society of China is supplying the disaster-hit area with medical supplies.
questions.cn: 中国红十字会正在向灾区提供医疗物资。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：sup（在...下面，引申为补充）+ ply（折叠/填满）= 补充，供应。
questions.prompt: n. 供应(量)；[pl.] 补给品 & vt. 供应；供给

questions.meaning: vi. 生存 & vt. 幸存；度过
questions.context_sentence: Few sheep and cows survived the snowstorm.
questions.cn: 很少有绵羊和奶牛在暴风雪中幸存下来。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：sur-（在...之上/超越）+ vive（活）= 越过危险活下来，幸存。
questions.prompt: Few sheep and cows ____ the snowstorm. (提示: vi. 生存 & vt. 幸存；度过)

questions.meaning: vi. & vt. 轻叩；轻敲 & n. 水龙头；轻敲
questions.context_sentence: He tapped on the pipe to make a sound.
questions.cn: 他轻敲管子发出声音。
questions.hint: 拟声词：tap, tap, tap，轻敲的声音。
questions.prompt: vi. & vt. 轻叩；轻敲 & n. 水龙头；轻敲

questions.meaning: vi. 吹口哨；发出笛声 & n. 哨子；呼啸声
questions.context_sentence: He blew his whistle for help.
questions.cn: 他吹响哨子求救。
questions.hint: 拟声词：whistle的发音十分接近吹哨子时的嘘嘘声。
questions.prompt: vi. 吹口哨；发出笛声 & n. 哨子；呼啸声

questions.meaning: adj. 镇静的；沉着的 & vt. 使平静；使镇静
questions.context_sentence: Staying calm is the most important rule.
questions.cn: 保持镇静是最重要的规则。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：l不发音，卡姆（calm），安静下来。
questions.prompt: Staying ____ is the most important rule. (提示: adj. 镇静的；沉着的)

questions.meaning: n. 援助；帮助；救援物资 & vi. & vt. 帮助；援助
questions.context_sentence: We received aid from the people.
questions.cn: 我们收到了人民的援助。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：aid 帮助。first aid是急救。
options: n. 援助；帮助；救援物资 & vi. & vt. 帮助；援助
n. 目标；目的 & vi. & vt. 瞄准
n. 空气；大气 & vt. 晾干

questions.meaning: vt. & vi. 碰撞 & n. 碰撞；撞车
questions.context_sentence: A truck went out of control and crashed into the back of a bus.
questions.cn: 一辆卡车失控撞上了公共汽车的尾部。
questions.hint: 拟声记忆：crash，重物撞击、碎裂的声音。
options: vt. & vi. 碰撞 & n. 碰撞；撞车

questions.meaning: vt. & vi. 打扫；消灭；彻底消除
questions.context_sentence: A raging wildfire sweeping through a dense forest.
questions.cn: 肆虐的山火席卷了茂密的森林。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：s + weep（哭泣）= 拿着扫帚一边扫地一边哭泣。
options: vt. & vi. 打扫；消灭；彻底消除
vi. & vt. 睡觉 & n. 睡眠
vi. & vt. 哭泣 & n. 哭泣

questions.meaning: n. 海浪；波浪 & vi. & vt. 挥手；招手
questions.context_sentence: A massive tsunami wave.
questions.cn: 巨大的海啸浪潮。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：水波（wave）起伏，像手在挥舞（wave）。

questions.meaning: vi. & vt. 侵袭；突击；击打 & n. 罢工；袭击
questions.context_sentence: An earthquake can strike suddenly.
questions.cn: 地震可能会突然袭来。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：保龄球全倒叫strike，给人以强烈的击打和侵袭感。
options: vi. & vt. 侵袭；突击；击打 & n. 罢工；袭击

questions.meaning: vt. & vi. 递送；传达 & vt. 发表
questions.context_sentence: Volunteers delivered food and supplies.
questions.cn: 志愿者们运送了食物和物资。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：de（向下）+ liver（肝脏/生命的供给）-> 送达生存必需品，即递送。
questions.prompt: Volunteers ____ food and supplies. (提示: vt. & vi. 递送；传达 & vt. 发表)

questions.context_sentence: Write a summary of the text.
questions.cn: 写一篇课文的总结。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：sum（总数，合计）+ ary（名词后缀）= 总结，概括。

questions.context_sentence: Write a summary of appropriate length.
questions.cn: 写一篇长度合适的总结。
questions.hint: 词性记忆：long（形容词，长的）的名词形式，发音和拼写发生改变。

questions.context_sentence: Tick the disasters that you hear: volcanic eruption.
questions.cn: 勾选你听到的灾害：火山喷发。
questions.hint: 组合记忆：volcanic（火山的）+ eruption（喷发，erupt的名词形式）。
questions.prompt: Tick the disasters that you hear: ____.

questions.context_sentence: What was the magnitude of the earthquake in Ecuador?
questions.cn: 厄瓜多尔地震的震级是多少？
questions.hint: 词根记忆：magn（大）+ i + tude（名词后缀，表状态）= 大小、级别。

questions.context_sentence: What are the rescue workers and soldiers doing in the flood-hit area?
questions.cn: 救援人员和士兵在受洪水袭击的地区做什么？
questions.hint: 联想记忆：re（再次）+ s + cue（线索/提示）-> 再次发现线索，展开营救。
questions.prompt: What are the ____ workers and soldiers doing in the flood-hit area?

questions.meaning: n. 避难处；居所；庇护 & vt. 保护；掩蔽 & vi. 躲避
questions.context_sentence: Shelters set up by the government.
questions.cn: 政府建立的避难所。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：shell（贝壳）+ ter -> 像贝壳一样的保护所，避难处。
options: n. 避难处；居所；庇护 & vt. 保护；掩蔽 & vi. 躲避
adj. 瘦小的 & vt. 怠慢

questions.context_sentence: At least one well had some smelly gas coming out of it.
questions.cn: 至少有一口井里冒出一些难闻的气体。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：gas（煤气/汽油），gas station是加油站。
questions.prompt: At least one well had some smelly ____ coming out of it.

questions.context_sentence: It seemed as if the world were coming to an end!
questions.cn: 看起来世界仿佛就要走到尽头了！
questions.hint: 短语记忆：as（如同）+ if（如果）= 就像是，仿佛。

questions.meaning: phr. 严重受损；破败不堪
questions.context_sentence: In less than one minute, a large city lay in ruins.
questions.cn: 不到一分钟，一座大城市就变成了一片废墟。
questions.hint: 短语记忆：in（在...中）+ ruins（废墟）= 处于废墟之中。
questions.prompt: In less than one minute, a large city lay ____.

questions.meaning: n. 百分之…… & adj. & adv. 每一百中
questions.context_sentence: About 75 percent of the city's factories and buildings, 90 percent of its homes, and all of its hospitals were gone.
questions.cn: 大约百分之七十五的工厂和建筑、百分之九十的住宅以及所有的医院都消失了。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：per（每）+ cent（百，如cent分币）= 每一百中，百分之。
options: n. 百分之…… & adj. & adv. 每一百中
adj. 现在的；出席的 & n. 礼物

questions.context_sentence: The railway tracks were now useless pieces of metal.
questions.cn: 铁轨现在成了毫无用处的金属废品。
questions.hint: 对比记忆：metal是金属，mental是精神的。少个n（脑），就只是冰冷的金属。
questions.prompt: The railway tracks were now useless pieces of ____.

questions.context_sentence: Water, food, and electricity were hard to get.
questions.cn: 水、食物和电很难弄到。
questions.hint: 词根记忆：electric（电的）+ ity（名词后缀）= 电，电能。
